trimmingSuggestions.description: The initial animation of the title card could be shortened by a second or two to get to the content quicker.
In the Eventbrite website demonstration (Scene 2), showing fewer event categories would make it more concise.
The segment showcasing company logos that use Loom (Scene 3, 0:29-0:32) could be shortened or removed. While it builds credibility, it slows down the pace.
